title: Discovering: Sean Connery
description: A look at the life and career of the Scottish actor, who rose to fame as the original screen James Bond and won an Oscar for his role in The Untouchables.

title: The Directors
description: The life and work of English film-maker Carol Reed, who directed movies including The Third Man, Odd Man Out and Our Man in Havana, and won an Oscar for 1968 musical Oliver!

title: Rise of the Superheroes
description: A look at how the tales of comic book superheroes like Batman and the Avengers were adapted for cinema before going on to dominate Hollywood and captivate audiences worldwide.

title: Jackie Stewart
description: Documentary about Formula 1 great Jackie Stewart, from his humble beginnings outside Glasgow to winning three World Drivers' Championships.

title: I Am Paul Walker
description: Documentary exploring the life and legacy of American actor Paul Walker, who rose to fame in the Fast and Furious franchise, but died at the age of 40 after a car crash.

title: Be Water
description: A look at Bruce Lee's time in Hong Kong making four films, exploring questions of identity and representation through rare archive, intimate interviews, and Lee's writings.

title: Bruno v Tyson
description: The story of the boxing rivalry between Frank Bruno and Mike Tyson, spanning two epic fights marred by politics and volatile race relations, with the old foes coming together for a reunion.

title: My Icon: Duke McKenzie
description: The former world champion boxer talks about the individuals that have been an inspiration to him over the course of his career.

title: Rik Mayall: Magnificent B'stard
description: A documentary tribute to the influential and much-missed comedian, a man driven by punk spirit and an unrelenting commitment to pushing boundaries. When he died in 2014 at the age of 56, Rik left behind a body of ground-breaking work, from Rick the Poet and Kevin Turvey to The Young Ones, Bottom and The New Statesman - performances that redefined television comedy and helped ignite the alternative comedy revolution. The film explores his comedic journey, his creative partnership with Adrian Edmo

title: God Bless Ozzy Osbourne
description: A profile of Black Sabbath member Ozzy Osbourne, from the wild and hedonistic days that adversely affected his personal life, through the years of depression, alcoholism and drug dependency that followed. The programme also reveals how he overcame his demons, with the help of his second wife Sharon. Featuring interviews with Paul McCartney, Motley Crue drummer Tommy Lee and others.

title: Tina
description: Born Anna Mae Bullock in 1939, Tina Turner has sold in excess of 100 million records and earned numerous plaudits including Grammy awards and induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame with her first husband, Ike Turner. She was the first woman to grace the cover of Rolling Stone magazine and dabbled in acting including a memorable performance opposite Mel Gibson in Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome. title: Jealous Guy: The Assassination of John Lennon
description: An exploration of the life and career of the Beatles superstar, with a look at the strange parallels between him and his killer Mark David Chapman.

title: Terry Venables: A Man Can Dream
description: A look at the life and times of the former footballer and manager, who died in November 2023, intertwined with the story of England's unforgettable run at Euro 96, with insight from players, friends and family.

title: The Directors
description: The life and work of John Frankenheimer, who directed films including Birdman of Alcatraz, The Manchurian Candidate, French Connection II, Black Sunday and Ronin.

title: Discovering: Robin Williams
description: A profile of the American actor and comedian, who starred in Good Morning, Vietnam and Dead Poets Society and won an Oscar for his role in Good Will Hunting.

title: Discovering: Robert De Niro
description: A profile of the American actor, who starred in Taxi Driver, Goodfellas and The King of Comedy and won Academy Awards for his roles in The Godfather Part II and Raging Bull.

title: The Directors
description: The life and work of Italian film-maker Sergio Leone, whose influential movies include A Fistful of Dollars, The Good, the Bad and the Ugly and Once Upon a Time in America.

title: Lancaster
description: The story of the bomber synonymous with the Dambusters, the night raids against Germany and the brave men and women who made them possible.

title: Spitfire
description: The story of the British single-seat fighter plane the Supermarine Spitfire, designed by RJ Mitchell and famous for its role in the Battle of Britain. Archive footage, new film of the aircraft in flight and interviews with the last surviving veterans who flew the plane in combat combine to tell its story.

title: The Commandant's Shadow
description: Documentary following the son of the man who was in charge of Auschwitz concentration camp as he confronts his father's involvement in the murder of more than a million Jews.

title: When We Were Kings
description: Leon Gast's Oscar-winning documentary charting the challenge of an ageing Muhammad Ali for George Foreman's World Heavyweight title held in Zaire in 1974. The film explores the impact of Ali's visit to Africa before focusing on the epic fight, dubbed the 'Rumble in the Jungle', which has gone down in history as one of the greatest of all time. Spike Lee and Norman Mailer are among the contributors offering personal opinions on its importance to them.

title: My Icon: Johnny Nelson (Pt1)
description: The former world champion boxer discusses the individuals that have inspired him in his life and career. Part 1.

title: Apollo 11
description: Documentary made to mark the 50th anniversary of the moon landings, presenting the story of the iconic space mission through a newly discovered trove of 70mm archive footage and still photographs and drawing on thousands of hours of audio recordings. Featuring the personal accounts of the astronauts, the team in Mission Control, and the millions of spectators on the ground.

title: My Icon: Leon Pryce
description: The former Bradford Bulls and St Helens star discusses the individuals that have inspired him in his life and sporting career.

title: My Mom Jayne
description: Actress Mariska Hargitay explores the life of her mother Jayne Mansfield, who died in a car accident at the age of 34 when Mariska was only three years old. Through intimate interviews and a collection of never-before-seen photos and home movies, the Law & Order: Special Victims Unit star grapples with her mother's public and private legacy and discovers the layers and depth of who she was, not only to her audience but to those who were closest to her.

title: Gary
description: A look at the life and mysterious death of actor Gary Coleman, who shot to fame as Arnold in hit sitcom Diff'rent Strokes.

title: Belushi
description: The life story of comedy star John Belushi, who captured the hearts and funny-bones of audiences worldwide before his tragic and untimely death aged 33.
